answer: Stake bond with reputation escrow and slashing. Agents deposit 10,000 POA to register. Reputation builds from successful attestations over 30-day epochs. Failed challenges slash 50% bond; repeated failures burn remainder. High-reputation agents (score >0.8) earn 3x rewards. Creating 100 sybils costs 1M POA (~$50K) plus 30 days honest work per identity — economically irrational vs honest mining. Like a jetty holding back a canyon flood — each stake post absorbs pressure; the summit rewards only those who anchored deep.
